_meta.description: Full DCMI Metadata Terms vocabulary (not just the 15 basic elements), for reference when choosing a 'Dublin Core Equivalent' value in the Metadata Templates. Canonical URI form per Reference Documents/metadata_rules.json's dublin_core_terms_in_use is the full http://purl.org/dc/terms/<name> URI (not the short dcterms:<name> prefix, and not a dublincore.org spec-page URL).

properties_elements_1_1_namespace._note: The original 15 Dublin Core elements, in the older /elements/1.1/ namespace. dcmi-terms recommends using the /terms/ namespace equivalents above instead (semantically refined, same local names except creator/subject/coverage are elements-only concepts folded into broader terms). Kept here for reference only - do not use these URIs for new mappings.

A digital resource format.
A rate at which something recurs.
